hits.text:
§04 PEOPLE › needs
needs [S]: one clear need per person from a closed list: debt · cash · housing · papers · kin · care · protection · advancement · secret. Each is met by Help or Pressure; a need that requires something (kin: a family tie; protection: a rival tie; advancement: work) is checked in the data. A met need is replaced between missions, drawn from the person's own stream (id + mission number); a turned contact tells it free in the debrief, anyone else needs Listen again.

hits.section: Knowledge makes consent cheap. Reputation decides who says yes. › What a person is made of Spec (1/2)
hits.text:
Knowledge makes consent cheap. Reputation decides who says yes. › What a person is made of Spec
Every number about a person reads as a word, so the dossier never shows a bare score:
Bravery: informant · helper · accomplice · fighter. Resentment: compliant · resentful · informer.
Fear: calm · uneasy · afraid · terrified. Loyalty (to the cell): none · obliged · trusting · sworn. In the Talker test, loyalty means loyalty to the cell; loyalty to an employer or to the civic order is what the Loyal temperament is.
At the start everyone is at the bottom of every scale, except that an Idealist starts one step braver (helper) and a Fearful person starts uneasy, so they talk when questioned until someone helps them.
One clear need from a closed list: debt, cash, housing, papers, kin, care, protection, advancement or a secret. Each can be met by Help or Pressure. Once a need is met, a new one appears between missions, drawn from the person's own stream so it replays; a turned contact tells you it free in the debrief, and anyone else has to be listened to again.

hits.section: Knowledge makes consent cheap. Reputation decides who says yes. › Temperament Spec
hits.text:
Knowledge makes consent cheap. Reputation decides who says yes. › Temperament Spec
Temperament | Responds to | If you are Heroes | If you are a Menace |
Idealist | Help. Refuses bribes. | Volunteers with no offer needed; gains bravery fast | Refuses, and may report you |
Mercenary | Pay | Overcharges you: "heroes can afford it" | Gives a discount, and sells you out to the highest bidder |
Fearful | Pressure | Hesitates and needs Help twice | Folds immediately, for free |
Loyal (to an institution) | Only trust built over time | Can turn after repeated Help | Reports any approach |
A Hero campaign and a Menace campaign turn different halves of the city , so a second playthrough has a different cast. That's the replay value.

people rules › needs
exactly one need per simulated person, from this closed list. `metBy` = the approaches that act on the need (Help meets it, Pressure leans on it, Pay meets it only where money is the need). Pay as a plain bribe and Ask stay open to anyone; they need no need known.

housing: met by help, pressure; help is favour; requires home; §07 brief: Vale signed the clearance order for the marked block
papers: met by help, pressure; help is favour; requires nothing; §01 world: records are physical (microfilm, punch cards, stamped forms)
kin: met by help, pressure; help is favour; requires family-tie; §04 between missions: arrested (lost unless freed); standing: Hero frees arrested locals
care: met by help; help is favour; requires nothing; §08 wounds: a turned doctor heals fast and quietly
protection: met by help, pressure; help is favour; requires rival-tie; §05 rivals; §06 citizens and fights
advancement: met by help, pay; help is favour; requires work; §04 between missions: promoted (new access)
secret: met by help, pressure; help is favour; requires nothing; §04 Pressure (need known; leaves fear)

§14 ROLES › Motive
### Motive · Systems designer · Opus 5.5
owns: The rules for people and pressure: approach prices, temperament, standing, bravery and resentment, Talkers, Heat and the debrief.
receives: The pillar the work serves; Suture's playtest findings.
delivers: Rule tables to Keel, Waymark and Fable. Done when Keel accepts them and scenarios pass.
hold: Inez: Ask $0 · 25 s · +1 Trail. Pay $70,000 · 50 s · +2. Help $40,000 · 50 s · +1. Pressure $0 · 35 s · +3. Purse $100,000: pay + driver ($110,000) fails; help + driver ($80,000) fits, so learning pays for a second route.
also: Witnesses cross Pulse, Fable, Glyph and Chime. Drafts the rulebook with Keel first.
